node.title: Mapping — Maya's 'empower the team, never rank it' → Developer Experience
node.summary: Maps 'help not surveillance; improve the team without ranking individuals' to DevEx that exposes variability across teams, not people.
node.interview_question: How do you guarantee a 'team variability' view doesn't get turned into an individual ranking by the customer's own managers?

competitor.name: DX (Atlassian)
competitor.positioning: DX (Atlassian) is the gold standard for survey-based, non-ranking DevEx measurement and would be Maya's natural first call here.
